name: MU AI High-Bandwidth Memory Supercycle Valuation
rationale: Micron Technology, Inc. (MU) is one of only three global producers of High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM3e/HBM4) vital to every modern AI accelerator. TTM revenue surged +345.7% YoY to $37.38B. While fundamental DCF yields $695.61 (-25.9% vs $938.32 current) due to conservative cycle down-turn modeling, the forward P/E of 6.05x and $1,513.41 Wall Street consensus reflect sustained HBM profitability. Recommendation: MAINTAIN (Core Holding: 1.2 shares, 3.55% target weight). Maintain current position size, accumulate only on pullbacks near $848.55, and execute partial trims into resistance above $1,050.00.

bear.rationale: Severe memory downcycle following HBM3e/HBM4 capacity overbuild; margin compresses to 16% on $75.2B Y5 revenue.
risks: Samsung aggressive HBM4 capacity expansion crashing market ASPs
Cyclical downshift in enterprise server DRAM and consumer NAND pricing

base.rationale: High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM3e/HBM4) supply-demand stays tight with locked multi-year hyperscaler LTAs; revenue expands to $173.9B with 32% net margin.
risks: Hyperscaler capex consolidation causing temporary digestion pauses
Raw silicon and specialized packaging substrates supply friction

bull.rationale: Micron captures #1 market share in HBM4/HBM4e alongside CXL memory expansion; $283.8B revenue at 42% net margin commands premium AI multiple.
risks: Geopolitical tension in East Asia impacting offshore packaging lines
Next-generation optical interconnects reducing total HBM memory stack height
